product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Corban Contemporary 2-Drawer Media Console, 75"W, Gray
product.description: The 2 self-closing drawers and 2 cabinets in this sleek, modern media console offer plenty of storage space for electronic and multimedia components. The strong lines and metal legs produce a contemporary flair, while the patterned panels add that touch of elegance every home needs. 75"W x 19.7"D x 24.4"H Engineered wood with metal legs This modern media console makes a wonderful accent piece in any home. The 2 self-closing drawers and 2 cabinets make this media console great for storage. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
